map.MD5 还能用于安全吗？: Can MD5 still be used for security?
map.不建议，已被碰撞攻破，仅用于非安全完整性校验。: Not recommended. Its collisions have been broken, so use it only for non-security integrity checks.
map.MD5 和 CRC32 有什么不同？: How does MD5 differ from CRC32?
map.CRC32 是为检测信道误码设计的，只有 32 位、碰撞极易构造；MD5 是密码: CRC32 was designed to detect transmission errors: it is only 32 bits and collisions are trivial to construct. MD5 is a cryptographic hash, 128 bits, originally designed to resist collisions. Although MD5 has been broken and can no longer be used for security, as a checksum in a non-adversarial setting its error-detection capability still beats CRC32.
